name: What should I prepare before requesting an estimate for listing repair work?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before requesting an estimate for listing repair work?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for a turnover estimate, compile a detailed punch list of every known defect, noting specific rooms and issues like cracked tiles or wall damage. Take clear photos, confirm whether you have leftover touch-up paint with matching sheen codes, and decide on your move-out or listing deadline. If the property has prior water stains from resolved plumbing leaks or roof storms, document that the underlying source is fixed so the drywall repair can proceed smoothly without recurring moisture risks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Create a detailed punch list, photograph damaged areas, locate any leftover matching paint, and confirm your hard deadline for open houses or tenant move-in dates.
